definitions.gloss: use-by date; expiration date; period of validity for use
definitions.explanation: The date or period up to which a product can be safely or effectively used. Commonly applied to medicines, cosmetics, and other non-food products.

examples.japanese: {使用期限|しようきげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{使用期限|しようきげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れている→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: This medicine is past its expiration date.

examples.japanese: {使用期限|しようきげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Cosmetics that are past their use-by date can cause skin problems.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧ (use) and ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧ (deadline, time limit). Refers to the last date a product should be used, as opposed to the date it should be consumed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {使用期限|しようきげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: to expire (use-by date)
- {使用期限|しようきげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to go past the use-by date
- {使用期限|しようきげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the use-by date
- {使用期限|しようきげん}{内|ない}: within the use-by date

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{賞味期限|しょうみきげん}→賞味期限：06076_shoumikigen⟧: best-before date — for food; indicates when quality is best, not safety
- ⟦{消費期限|しょうひきげん}→消費期限：06077_shouhikigen⟧: expiration date (for consumption) — for perishable food; a safety deadline
- ⟦{有効期限|ゆうこうきげん}→有効期限：06415_yuukoukigen⟧: expiration date (for validity) — for licenses, passes, contracts, etc.

USAGE:
In Japan, {使用期限|しようきげん} is most commonly found on medicine packaging and cosmetics. It is distinct from the food-related terms ⟦{賞味期限|しょうみきげん}→賞味期限：06076_shoumikigen⟧ and ⟦{消費期限|しょうひきげん}→消費期限：06077_shouhikigen⟧.
